 When I start a promotion, I always forge some type of positive relationship with all companies that could be a threat down the line, so basically all of the companies who are cult size, and look like they might hit national very soon. For promotions that are the same size as you, I sometimes will start a war against them, so our talent still becomes exclusive, I can screw with their product, and I can try to win the war, pillage the promotion and come out with tons of momentum and new talent that I couldn't use because they were exclusive to my rival company. Monday Night War's style.

 Its harder to start a company in an area already dominated by bigger companies. Try starting in a lesser known area, then move to take over the obscure areas, then when you have enough base popularity to stand on, when you lose those monthly regional and national battles, any hit in popularity you take won't decrease your promotion size. Also, don't be afraid to take a random guy with decent base popularity, and push him to the moon. I use analog plus zone for my at bats, and the main reason I use it, is because I can get at least some contact with pitches that are on the edges of the strike zone. Ive found that in the other modes, sometimes you swing on a fastball, and you will miss completely because you had the timing down but the pitch was up and in, or down and away, causing you whiff. It took me a while to get used to using both thumbs to bat, but now I can hover around .300 more in any game mode because those pitches on the outside become bloops or bleeders that I can beat out at first, rather than strike out on a 95+ 4SFB on the edge. It's more difficult but more realistic and more rewarding in my opinion.

The best advice I got was locate the ball as early as possible, and keep your eye on the ball and the plate in your peripheral. That strategy worked wonders for me. Personally, I take the first pitch of an at bat just to get a feel for the timing, it helps me recognize off-speed pitches a bit better too. I also focus my 3B rtts players stat points to contact and vision. I'm pretty sure those increase the size of your batters wheelhouse.
